prompt: When holding the Crescent Axe from Demon's Souls (2009) in two hands, what is the physical damage reduction when blocking?
answer: The **Crescent Axe has 55% physical damage reduction when blocking**, even when wielded two-handed. Two-handing changes its effective Strength and moveset, but not its blocking reduction.
